assignment.title: Validate and store an assignment
assignment.description: Implement AssignmentRepository.Create using an injected DbConnection. Validate inputs before executing a parameterized INSERT. The caller owns connection opening and disposal; the caller passes the current UTC time. Do not embed credentials or log submitted titles.

requirements.title: Validate title
requirements.description: Reject null, empty, and whitespace-only titles before executing SQL.

requirements.title: Validate deadline
requirements.description: Reject dueAtUtc when it is less than or equal to the supplied nowUtc before executing SQL.

requirements.title: Parameterize storage
requirements.description: Insert the title and deadline through database parameters. Do not concatenate submitted values into SQL.
